from cache import make_key
from service import score


def test_all_inputs_affect_caching():
    """Changing any of job_text/profile_version/criteria_version recomputes."""
    for text in ["", "a", "ab"]:
        for pv in [None, 1, 2]:
            for cv in [None, 0, 1]:
                for (t, p, c) in [("x", None, None), ("x", None, 1), ("x", 1, None), ("x", 1, 1), ("y", 1, 1), ("xy", 2, 3)]:

def test_reuse_when_inputs_unchanged():
    """Same inputs across calls reuse the same store entry."""
    called = []
    def compute():
        called.append(1)
        return called[-1]

    store = {}
    res1 = score(store, "q", 2, 3, compute)
    res2 = score(store, "q", 2, 3, compute)
    assert store.get("q") == res1 == res2
    assert len(called) == 1


def test_none_inputs_reused_and_not_ambiguous():
    """None values are fine and don't create ambiguous keys."""
    called = {}
    def compute(k):
        called[k] = called.get(k, 0) + 1
        return called[k]

    store = {}
    a = score(store, "n", None, None, compute)
    b = score(store, "n", None, None, compute)
    assert a == b == 1
    assert len(called) == 1


def test_each_input_variant_triggers_recompute():
    """Only identical full input reuses; any change recomputes."""
    base = ["t", 1, 2]
    variants = [
        ["t", 1, 2],
        ["t", 1, None],
        ["t", None, 2],
        ["t", None, None],
        ["t", 2, 2],
        ["t", 1, 3],
        ["t2", 1, 2],
    ]
    calls = {}
    def compute(k):
        calls[k] = calls.get(k, 0) + 1
        return calls[k]

    store = {}
    first = score(store, "t", 1, 2, compute)
    assert store[key(*base)] == first
    for v in variants[1:]:
        assert store[key(*v)] != store.get(key(*base))


def test_concatenation_never_mixes():
    """Consecutive different inputs must never share a key."""
    A = ["a", 1, 2]
    B = ["aa", None, None]
    C = ["a", 1, None]
    store = {}
    for args in [A, B, A, C, B, A]:
        score(store, args[0], args[1], args[2], lambda k: k)
    for key in [key(*A), key(*B), key(*C)]:
        assert key in store
        assert store[key] == key
